question: Owner 2026-10-27: 最后一根5mink线 在第3 4分钟的时候判断呗  是我们要的就还是挂单  测试一下？有多少能继续挂到的？有多少失去了的？
single_variable: Decision time inside the touch 5m bar (minute D, partial-bar vol_ratio / liquidity / toward24 from Binance UM 1m); an order rests from the previous close if the causal score already clears 0.5. Frozen model, threshold and v3 fills unchanged.
source: https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/klines/{symbol}/1m/ (public archive, touch days of v3 parents only)
null_control: Not a directional experiment. Controls: D = 5 rebuilt from 1m must reproduce the stored score and 1m high/low must match the 5m bar; the kept/lost split is reported against the previous-close-only rule on the same fills.
limits: 1m resolution: a touch in minute D counts as after the decision. Orders placed at minute D on levels not touched in that bar, and non-v3 events whose partial score clears 0.5, are not measured. In sample.
